convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ColorTSI-Oscillator' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator buffers require manual recreation in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for long entry signal
DnSignalTime - timestamp for short entry signal

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: sell signal closes long (if BuyPosClose=true), buy signal closes short (if SellPosClose=true). Closing is permission-gated by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM=0.1 is share of deposit. MMMode selects calculation method: FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, or LOT (fixed lot). Default MMMode=LOT means MM is treated as fixed lot size.

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses two-bar comparison: Ind[1] vs Sign[1] (previous confirmed bar) and Ind[0] vs Sign[0] (current forming bar). Buy triggers when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (indicator was above signal on previous bar) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (crossover just happened on current bar). Sell is the mirror. SignalBar input (default=1) determines which bar index is used for data copy. When SignalBar==0, the new-bar guard is bypassed and signals are recalculated every tick. The Recount flag triggers re-read of indicator buffers on failure. Trade functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle all order execution internally. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Must recreate the ColorTSI-Oscillator custom indicator in Python. It is a TSI (True Strength Index) oscillator with dual smoothing (First_Method/Second_Method supporting SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA). The smoothing algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) are non-standard and require faithful porting. Entry logic is a crossover system on SignalBar-shifted buffers. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions handle position opening/closing with SL/TP, deviation, and money management - these must be reimplemented. Note that SL/TP are in points (not pips), and no digit-adjustment is performed, so on 5-digit brokers the user must account for this in input values. The entry crossover logic uses Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (not strictly crossing, but less-than-or-equal on the current bar relative to previous bar's above state), which is a specific pattern to verify carefully.
